integrityRules: Never invent a value (phone, name, figure). If unfound, omit it or set `flagged: true` with a note like "verify by phone".
Every value must carry `provenance.source` (a URL) OR be `flagged`. Unsourced, unflagged values are rejected by the harness.
Only fill the gap fields listed for each subject — do not re-research satisfied fields.
Emit a `bubbles` entry of kind "serendipity" for anything useful you find that is outside the requested fields.

fields.hint: one or two sentences: what the project is and what graphical content it puts in or beside a terminal
SPDX id from the repo (gh api repos/O/R --jq .license.spdx_id) or 'proprietary' with the vendor page as source
primary implementation language(s), from the repo's language breakdown or docs

HOW pixels or rich content get there: native GPU drawing, Kitty graphics protocol, Sixel, iTerm2 OSC 1337, Unicode half/quadrant/sextant blocks, separate overlay OS window, embedded webview/browser engine, DOM (Electron/xterm.js) … cite the doc or source file
split pane | floating panel | inline in scrollback | fullscreen | separate OS window | cell-anchored overlay — say which, and whether it scrolls with text
how mouse and keys reach the embedded thing (focus model, mouse passthrough, keyboard capture, escape key)
stars, last push / last release date — measured with `gh api repos/O/R` (source: 'measured 2026-09-24: gh api repos/O/R') or the vendor's release page
comma-separated tags from exactly this vocabulary: open-on-click, pane-content, floating, host-protocol, tui-wm, agent-panes, same-stack — or 'none'. Drives the derived closeness score.
THE one idea Terminal Delight should take from it, concrete enough to act on (inferred — say so in the note)
what TD should avoid, learned from this project's design or its issue tracker
space-separated repo/docs URLs actually read; mark blog posts or AI summaries as 'synthesis:'
